title: Circularo Strategic Partnership & Investment Opportunity
contentStatus: Company-source investor draft with visible review placeholders. Financials are management-reported.

slides.title:
Strategic partnership
& investment
slides.body:
Digital trust technology for
enterprises and governments
slides.notes: Circularo is headquartered in Dubai. It connects documents, identity, approvals, trust services and process evidence. Circularo seeks a strategic shareholder that can accelerate adoption within its own businesses and wider customer network. The purpose of this discussion is commercial fit alongside minority ownership.

review.text: Add the ARR basis and EBITDA reconciliation so investors can assess recurring revenue and earnings quality.

slides.notes: All amounts are USD. Source exact 2025 figures: revenue $2,793,981 and adjusted EBITDA $858,816, rounded here to three decimal places in millions. Current approximate ARR is a separate founder statement with no exact measurement date. The source financials are not represented as audited. Finance must supply the adjusted EBITDA definition and reconciliation. Gross profit/COS do not reconcile in the supplied source, so gross margin is excluded. Suggested diligence evidence: latest actual reporting period, recurring revenue definition, retention and customer concentration. Reconcile ADIB treatment before adding churn statistics. No net profit or cash-generation claim is made.

slides.notes: Illustrative agreement process assembled from source-described capabilities, not a customer case study or universal configuration. An evidence record spans the process. Applications and AI agents can participate through programmable capabilities. Trusted execution means acting with appropriate authority and retaining a record of what happened. No universal legal validity or claim to govern an AI model's reasoning.

review.label: TO ADD [partner adoption model]
review.text: Add eligible accounts, timing and retained ARR to test the commercial scale.

slides.notes: SaaS is an existing delivery model. Group adoption and distribution are proposed commercial mechanisms, not signed partner commitments. The ribbon establishes a development sequence, not a dated sales forecast. A prospective shareholder may not control portfolio-company procurement. Model eligible businesses, addressable customer accounts, adoption timing, net retained recurring value, channel economics and delivery resources. Do not assume improved margin or lower acquisition cost. Owner: CEO / CSO with a named partner.

slides.title: A joint ARR growth ambition
slides.gap: Approximately $6M of net ARR growth across the business

review.label: TO ADD [a reconciled commercial growth model]
review.text: Show churn, expansion, new contracts, timing and delivery capacity to substantiate the ambition.

slides.notes: Approximately $9M is 3 times approximately $3M. Approximately $6M is the arithmetic difference, not a booked pipeline or revenue attributed entirely to a partner. All amounts USD. Management ambition, not forecast or committed return. The 2–3-year horizon has no agreed calendar start and is not an exit timetable. Ending ARR = opening ARR minus churn/contraction plus existing-customer expansion plus new recurring business. Assign incremental contracts once to existing commercial activity, group deployment, partner-distributed SaaS or a new shared-service contract. AI/eDocs recurring value belongs within the relevant contract; geography is a tag. Remove overlaps with existing pipeline and use recurring revenue retained by Circularo after channel economics. Exclude one-off implementation revenue. Owner: CEO / CSO / finance with prospective partner.

slides.title: $10–15M

lead.heading: Up to 25% minority ownership
lead.body: Primarily founder secondary. Founders continue as CEO and CSO (Chief of Sales).

items.heading: Commercial role
items.body: The shareholder could adopt the platform or distribute it to customers.

items.heading: Shared ownership
items.body: Participation in the equity value created through successful expansion.

items.heading: Flexible structure
items.body: Strategic fit remains central. Final terms and valuation are subject to agreement.

items.heading: Execution commitment
items.body: An active commercial sponsor and an agreed plan turn access into deployment.

review.label: TO ADD [expansion funding + ownership plan]
review.text: Clarify any primary component and governance. Secondary proceeds go mainly to selling founders.

slides.notes: Preferred transaction is USD $10–15M with minority ownership up to 25%, primarily acquisition of existing founder shares. The range and 'up to' percentage do not fix valuation. Most proceeds under the working secondary structure would go to selling founders; do not describe the transaction as a company growth budget. Primary component, expansion funding, governance rights and post-transaction ownership remain open. No return multiple, liquidity guarantee, exclusivity or commercial commitment has been agreed. A meaningful minority holding aligns incentives but does not itself ensure execution. Owner: founders / finance.

slides.title:
Partnership
discussion
slides.body: Agree opportunities, commercial owners, resources and an ARR plan.
slides.notes: Circularo brings its established platform, government and enterprise references and live capabilities. The right shareholder can support deployment within its businesses and new customers and markets. Discuss initial opportunities, commercial sponsorship and delivery resources, a joint ARR expansion plan, minority ownership and long-term alignment. Future paths may include an IPO, private equity or a further strategic investment; route and timing remain open. The ARR horizon does not establish an exit timetable. Contact from the supplied deck outline.
